headline: Kazakhstan and China Discuss Doubling Shymkent Oil Refinery Capacity
summary: Kazakhstan and China discussed plans to double the annual processing capacity of the Shymkent oil refinery from 6 million to 12 million tonnes.

impacts.name: Kazakhstan
impacts.why: Expanding refinery processing capacity increases domestic petroleum product output potential.
